newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian banks review rates after RBA cut.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian banks review rates after RBA cut.

text.p: Australia's major banks said on Wednesday they were reviewing their interest rates following the surprise move by the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) to cut official cash rates by 0.5 percentage point to 6.0 percent.
Westpac Banking Corp said it was constantly reviewing its rates. Westpac's reference lending rate for corporate borrowers is currently 9.75 percent.
"We haven't made a decision yet," said Australia and New Zealand Banking Group spokeswoman Tania Hudson. ANZ's business reference (prime) rate stands at 9.85 percent.

"We'll have a look at the rates. You'll have to wait for a little while," National Australia Bank Ltd spokesman Haydn Park said. Last Friday NAB raised its benchmark (prime) lending rate to 9.90 percent from 9.85 percent.
The Commonwealth Bank of Australia was unavailable for comment.
The Commonwealth's prime lending business rate is 9.75 percent.
